name: customer-decision-learning
description: CD-12 weekly customer decision learning for one tenant: counts how often our decisions and organization defaults were overturned by the customer, recurring questions and change requests per entry, writes the tenant report knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/decisions/_reports/learning-<date>.json and queues improvement suggestions as organization learning candidates (source customer_decision, tier confidential, the tenant; once per suggestion and date). An operator accepts a candidate with `pnpm organization learning transition`; product templates are never changed automatically. Install into a tenant with `pnpm kyberion customer-decision learning --install --tenant <slug> --by user:<member>`; Chronos runs it only after a human approves its project trust.
